name: Abbey Church of Saint Gall
alias: Cathedral of Saint Gall;Collegiate Church of Saint Gall
description: Main church building of the Abbey of Saint Gall originally constructed under Abbot Gozbert.

name: Main Entrance Gate
description: Monumental main entrance portal on the western facade of the Abbey Church.

name: North Side Aisle
description: Northern side aisle of the Abbey Church housing lateral liturgical furnishings.

name: High Altar
description: Central liturgical altar situated in the choir of the Abbey Church.

name: Reliquary of Saint Gall
description: Ornate medieval reliquary shrine standing on the High Altar.

name: Altar of Saint Otmar
description: Side altar dedicated to Saint Otmar located in the North Side Aisle.

name: Relic of Saint Otmar
description: Reliquary vessel of Saint Otmar displayed on the Altar of Saint Otmar.

name: Tympanum Relief
description: Carved stone relief above the Main Entrance Gate.

name: Abbey Bell
description: Historical bronze bell of the Abbey Church of Saint Gall.
